modeling_decisions: Retain concept hollow truncated sack, tubular relief and basal seam. Correct concept round-vase appearance to a compressed elliptical fossil sack; fewer, finer 30 parallel ribs and an irregular but not ornamental broken rim. Ribs are integral undulations in one closed wall surface, not disconnected pipes. Modest infill is continuous with cavity floor, no coplanar overlay. No high fanlike sculptural walls: short uneven truncated margins, not preserved complete fans. Omit concept photoreal grain. Natural original morphology, not exact replica of a fossil.
